# S-013 · "DeepL Pro – Terms and Conditions"

## What it says

- DeepL's contracting entity, DeepL SE, is based in Cologne, Germany [W2-024].
- DeepL may process customer data on its own servers or on third-party cloud infrastructure, with no fixed geographic limit by default [W2-025].
